title: Is GLM 5.2 Better than Claude Opus 5?
description:
Claude Opus 5 is the model every serious coding agent runs on, but it costs $25 per million output tokens. 

A new open-weight model just matched it within one point on key benchmarks for a fraction of the price. 

In this video, I compare Claude Opus 5 against Z.ai's newly released GLM 5.2 — an MIT-licensed, self-hostable model that undercuts Opus on price by roughly 6x. 

I walk through the exact pricing, where Opus still dominates (long-horizon, high-stakes agentic work), where GLM 5.2 holds its own (Frontier Sui, MCP Atlas benchmarks), and who should actually be building on which model depending on volume and margin.
